ns2:section.sectionText: Registration restricted to MBA and graduate Architecture and Urban Planning students. Interested MAS students should contact Melinda Ohlsson to add their names to the course request list. The Finance Department will work with Melinda to place MAS students into 400-level Finance courses. Graduate students from other programs should contact the Finance Department directly about the possibility of enrolling.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Urban Planning or Landscape Architecture or Architecture or Business Administration (MBA) major(s). Restricted to Graduate - Urbana-Champaign.
